source.stem:
A person in a factory has to lift a box on to a shelf.
Which action involves the person doing the least amount of work?

options.text: lifting the box quickly to the high shelf
lifting the box slowly to the high shelf
lifting the box to the low shelf first then lifting it to the high shelf
lifting the box to the low shelf instead of to the high shelf

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Wool insulates equally well when its trapped air is replaced by water.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: A metal cup slows heat loss more than an otherwise identical porcelain cup.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Use metal for the handle because a cooking utensil should conduct heat easily throughout.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Painting a metal pan black makes it a poor conductor of heat.

intelligence.enrichment: Materials that allow heat to pass through them easily are good conductors; materials that do not allow heat to pass through easily are poor conductors or insulators. A material's ability to pass heat changes how quickly heat enters or leaves an object, so conductor materials support heating and insulator materials slow heat transfer. The learner correctly applies this rule: Materials that allow heat to pass through them easily are good conductors; materials that do not allow heat to pass through easily are poor conductors or insulators. A metal cup will keep tea hot longest because metal is sturdy, while material choice is not about heat flow.
